(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix Api keys. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/api-keys/api-keys/.
access_policy  tftypes.String computed
    description: Api Key Access Policy
active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Api Key Is Active.
hashed  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Api Key Is Hashed.
id  tftypes.String required
    description: ApiKey ID.
name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Api Key name.
owner  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Api Key Owner. It can either be a team_id, organisation_id, or a user_id 
owner.organisation_id  tftypes.String computed
owner.team_id  tftypes.String computed
owner.user_id  tftypes.String computed
permissions  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Api Key Permissions
presets  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Api Key Presets
value  tftypes.String computed
    description: The API key's secret value. The Coralogix backend returns this only when the key is first created; the Terraform provider captures it then and preserves it in resource state. Imported resources and data-source lookups cannot recover the value and will surface it as null.
